Test sceario: Verify that when a user adds a product to the comparison list from the Electronics section, the product is successfully added, a confirmation message appears, and the list count updates correctly.
Test steps: Navigate to Home > Electronics.     Locate a product in the list.     Click on the “Add to Compare” button for that product.
Expected result: The selected product is successfully added to the comparison list.       A success message (e.g., “Item added to comparison list successfully”) is displayed.      The comparison list count increases by one.
Actual Result: The selected product is successfully added to the comparison list.       A success message (e.g., “Item added to comparison list successfully”) is displayed.      The comparison list count increases by one.

Test sceario: Confirm that the “Write Your Friend an Email” feature correctly rejects invalid email formats.
Test steps:
Click on the “Write Your Friend an Email” option.
Enter an invalid email address (e.g., gjoihogeu) in the recipient email field.
Attempt to send the email.
Expected result:
The system detects the invalid email format.
The email is not sent.
A validation message appears (e.g., “Please enter a valid email address.”).
Actual Result: A validation message appears (e.g., “Please enter a valid email address.”).

Test sceario: Verify that the “Put Address Here to Order” feature validates the entered Zip Code format.
Test steps:
Click on the “Put Address Here to Order” field.
Enter an invalid Zip Code, such as "no number code".
Attempt to proceed with the order.
Expected result:
The system should validate the Zip Code format and display an error message (e.g., “Please enter a valid Zip Code.”).
The order should not proceed until a valid numeric Zip Code is entered.
Actual Result:
The system accepts invalid Zip Codes like "no number code".
The user is able to proceed without proper validation.

Test sceario: Ensure that entering invalid input (e.g., ////) in the Quantity field triggers a validation message.
Test steps:
Locate the Quantity field for the selected product.
Enter an invalid value, such as //// or any non-numeric input.
Attempt to add the item to the cart or proceed with the order.
Expected result:
The system detects the invalid input.
A validation message appears stating that the quantity must be a positive number (e.g., “Quantity must be a positive number.”).
The system prevents proceeding until a valid numeric value is entered.
Actual Result:
The system detects the invalid input.
A validation message appears stating that the quantity must be a positive number (e.g., “Quantity must be a positive number.”).

Test sceario: Verify that changing the “Items Per Page” setting to 3 limits the displayed products to three per page.
Test steps:
Locate the “Items Per Page” option on the product listing page.
Set the value to 3.
Observe the number of products displayed on the page.
Expected result:
Only three products are displayed on the current page.
Pagination (Next/Previous buttons) adjusts accordingly if more products exist.
No layout or display issues occur.
Actual Result:
Only three products are displayed on the current page.
Pagination (Next/Previous buttons) adjusts accordingly if more products exist.
No layout or display issues occur.

Test sceario: Check that changing the product display layout from horizontal to vertical updates the page layout correctly.

Expected result:

All product details (image, title, price, etc.) are properly aligned in vertical format.
No distortion or alignment issues appear on the page.
Actual Result:
The product layout successfully changes from Horizontal to Vertical.
All product details (image, title, price, etc.) are properly aligned in vertical format.
No distortion or alignment issues appear on the page.
